title: SWE-Opt: A Benchmark for Evaluating LLMs on Performance-Oriented Repository-Level Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2606.25530v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Software performance optimization is a notoriously complex and manual task. Despite the growing use of Large Language Models (LLMs) for code refinement, we still lack benchmarks that capture how optimization actually happens in real-world codebases. Existing frameworks often oversimplify the problem by focusing on isolated functions or a single performance metric, missing the critical trade-offs between execution time and memory footprint, the inherent noise of the measurement environment, and the variability introduced by different input data and execution conditions. translated_title: SWE-Opt：用于评估大语言模型在面向性能的仓库级优化任务上能力的基准
translated_abstract: 软件性能优化是一项出了名的复杂且高度依赖人工的任务。尽管大语言模型（LLM）在代码改进方面的应用日益增多，我们仍然缺乏能够真实反映优化在现实代码库中如何发生的基准。现有框架通常将问题过度简化，只关注孤立的函数或单一性能指标，从而忽略了执行时间与内存占用之间的关键权衡、测量环境固有的噪声，以及不同输入数据和执行条件所带来的变异性。为此，我们提出了 SWE-Opt，一个基于开源项目中 102 个专家手写优化案例构建的仓库级基准。与以往基准不同，SWE-Opt 为每个任务配备了参数化测试，在感知噪声的测量方式下，跨越不同的输入数据和执行条件，评估运行时间、峰值内存以及加权时间内存使用量（TWMU）……
tldr: SWE-Opt 提出了一个基于开源项目专家优化案例构建的仓库级基准，通过参数化测试在感知噪声的条件下多维度评估大语言模型的软件性能优化能力，弥补了现有基准忽略时间-内存权衡与执行环境变异性的不足。
en_tdlr: SWE-Opt introduces a repository-level benchmark derived from 102 expert-written optimizations in open-source projects, which evaluates LLMs on runtime, peak memory, and Time-Weighted Memory Usage under noise-aware measurements across varying inputs and execution conditions.
